basis_statement: Producer duplicate meaning, consumer dedupe, and authority-side exact-send identity use separate durable scopes. Packet ids and broker delivery counters never become legal truth.

scope_rows.collision_rule: BODY_COLLISION when one idempotency key is observed with a different command body hash.
scope_rows.recovery_posture: Safe retries return the original durable command receipt and never create a second logical command.
notes: Northbound duplicate scope binds actor or session, target, and payload meaning.
Consumer dedupe reuses the persisted command receipt rather than transport counters.

scope_rows.collision_rule: IDENTITY_NAMESPACE_COLLISION when the same stage idempotency key appears under a different stage code, manifest, or precondition hash.
scope_rows.recovery_posture: Duplicate dispatch reuses the same durable worker claim or completed result.
notes: Stage packets may be replayed; stage mutation may not.
Worker-local memory never defines legal completion.

scope_rows.collision_rule: BODY_COLLISION when one immutable object-version meaning resolves to different payload hashes.
scope_rows.recovery_posture: Rebuild from immutable object-version receipts and inbox truth, not provider event ordering.
notes: Immutable object identity is the dedupe spine.
Signed URLs and inline blob bytes are never part of the duplicate tuple.

scope_rows.collision_rule: BODY_COLLISION blocks transmit on payload drift; IDENTITY_NAMESPACE_COLLISION blocks transmit when a namespace tuple changes under one idempotency or request hash.
scope_rows.recovery_posture: Transport replay may reuse duplicate meaning and idempotency only when the exact sealed request meaning is unchanged.
notes: Request hash remains the exact-send identity and changes on token-binding or header-profile drift.
Idempotency follows duplicate meaning and survives lawful token rotation within one frozen lineage.

scope_rows.collision_rule: IDENTITY_NAMESPACE_COLLISION requires quarantine when one ingress payload resolves to competing request or authority identities.
scope_rows.recovery_posture: Restore resumes from canonical ingress receipts and reconciliation packets rather than nearest-recent request heuristics.
notes: Missing or stale source-record continuity blocks mutation and routes to quarantine.
